# RIPDPI

> RIPDPI is an Android network-path diagnostics and optimization toolkit. It measures why a target fails or degrades on a network, applies configurable packet strategies on the device, and can connect through relay servers the user controls.

- Platform: Android 8.1 and later. The core path needs no root.
- Modes: VPN mode (Android VpnService with a local bridge on the device) and proxy mode (a SOCKS5 proxy on localhost).
- Encrypted DNS: DoH, DoT, DNSCrypt and DoQ.
- Privacy: normal operation does not capture packets, keep traffic payloads or record TLS secrets.
- Licence: AGPL-3.0-only, or a commercial licence from the author.
- Status: in active development; breaking changes are possible.
- The project's own relay service is invite-only.
